game_concept: A action defense set in Snowy Hold – Furrier Lane, a lane of furriers: the sled courier must handle icicle bats while practicing functions. Core idea – Helper Factory: Refactor repeated code into helper functions to save time during a rush.
theme: Snowy Hold – Furrier Lane: a lane of furriers
core_gameplay_loop: In Furrier Lane, repeat each round: Refactor repeated code into helper functions to save time during a rush. Each round, icicle bats strike the ice mill, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the refactor_score value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the ice mill from icicle bats in Furrier Lane: keep the refactor_score meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 42-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: refactor_score drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 42-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 1 (intro tier): Helper Factory
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Helper Factory' (Week 6 slot 6), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Furrier Lane'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how refactor_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against icicle bats in Furrier Lane.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 42 seconds while refactor_score > 0.
